results.name: prior_four_obj_three_duplicate_singleton
results.description: On 4-object prior trials containing a unique singleton alongside three identical duplicate distractors, the mean points allocated to the singleton object.

results.name: prior_competing_sparse_minus_dense
results.description: On prior trials with duplicate 0-feature distractors and two singletons (sparse 1-feature vs dense all-features), the mean points allocated to the sparse singleton minus the dense singleton.

results.name: complex_competitor_minus_distractor_gap
results.description: On communicative trials with both a feature-rich competitor (true of the heard message) and a feature-rich distractor (false of the heard message), the mean point difference between the competitor and the distractor.

results.name: three_object_scalar_competitor_points
results.description: On 3-object communicative trials with a unique minimal target and an uninformative competitor satisfying the message, the mean points allocated to the competitor object.

results.name: prior_duplicate_background_points
results.description: On prior trials containing exactly one singleton among identical duplicate distractors, the total points allocated across all duplicate distractor objects combined.

results.name: maximal_vs_intermediate_competitor_preference
results.description: On communicative trials where the heard word fits a minimal target, an intermediate competitor, and a maximal-feature competitor, the mean point difference between the maximal competitor and the intermediate competitor.

results.name: prior_two_singletons_point_gap
results.description: On prior trials containing exactly two singletons alongside duplicate background distractors, the mean absolute difference in points allocated between the two singletons.

results.name: prior_all_singleton_full_complexity_points
results.description: On prior trials where all objects are distinct singletons with ascending feature counts from zero to all features, the mean points allocated to the all-features object.
